question: Should documented OpenClaw default-skill names resolve through an explicit trusted ClawHub mapping, remain local bundled skills, or require owner-qualified ClawHub references?
rationale: Current main deliberately avoids choosing among colliding publishers, and no checked-in data establishes which package—if any—is the trusted target for each default name.

options.title: Trusted official mapping
options.body: Map only documented default names to explicit trusted owner-qualified packages while retaining ambiguity errors for all other slugs.

options.title: Bundled-only resolution
options.body: Resolve default skills locally in OpenClaw and prevent their short names from falling through to ClawHub package lookup.

options.title: Owner-qualified only
options.body: Require all ClawHub installs to use owner-qualified references and improve errors and setup guidance for unscoped names.

recommendation.title: Trusted official mapping
recommendation.body: Map only documented default names to explicit trusted owner-qualified packages while retaining ambiguity errors for all other slugs.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and recently maintained the owner-scoped slug and API behavior that this decision would extend.
